[NDLC.6.1] The compiler validates dialect YAML files at load time.
Errors surface before any source file is touched:

| Condition | Message prefix |
|---|---|
| A `settings` key naming no capability | `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_UNKNOWN_CAPABILITY` ([NDLC.2.2]) |
| A capability absent from `settings` | `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_INCOMPLETE` ([NDLC.2.2]) |
| The settings violate a fundamental constraint | `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_DEPENDENCY` ([LCAP.3.8]) |
| The settings set `realtime` or `constspace` `true` | `DS_VALIDATE_REALTIME_DEFERRED` ([LCAP.2.1.5]) |
| The settings set a storage or samples-plane capability `true` | `DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DEFERRED` ([LCAP.2.10]) |
| `name` missing, empty, or not a `NAME` token, so that no `use` directive could name it ([LGRA.3.1]) | `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_BAD_NAME` |
| Dialect name already registered | `DS_VALIDATE_DIALECT_DUPLICATE_NAME` |
| YAML syntax error | file path + `YAML parse error` |
| A top-level key other than `name` and `settings` ([NDLC.2.1]) | file path + the line and the key |
| `settings` absent, or not a mapping ([NDLC.2.2]) | file path + `settings must be a mapping` |

The last three are refusals of the file's shape, before any capability is
judged, and carry no `DS_VALIDATE_*` code.
